rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
rows.quote: Renewed for 1 year ($14.99) — now expires November 2027

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you for reaching out — I really appreciate the offer, and your skills are exactly what I need help with. Right now, I'm focused on building out Halcyon Threshold's research foundation. With 5 hours/week, here's what would be most valuable: 1. **Mapping neglected areas**: I'd love help compiling a landscape of what's being worked on vs. what isn't in superintelligence preparedness — policy gaps, technical areas with few researchers, underserved communities, etc. 2. **Data on AI progress indicators**: Collecting and tracking key metrics that might signal how close we are to transformative capabilities — benchmark progressions, compute trends, lab announcements. If either of those sounds interesting to you, let's set up a quick call to discuss scope and how to collaborate. What does your week look like? Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Email to Priya Raman accepting her volunteer help, with concrete tasks (mapping neglected areas, tracking AI progress indicators)
